title: Unchanged number of lawyers with active licenses to practice in cities located within LaSalle County in March compared to previous month
text:
Lawyer Member, St. Charles - Kate L. McCracken | isba.org
Lawyer Member, St. Charles - Kate L. McCracken | isba.org
ARDC of the Supreme Court of Illinois.
In total, there were 77 active legal licenses recorded in cities in LaSalle County in March.
The majority of these active licenses were granted in Ottawa (56).
A 2023 study found Illinois had the fourth-highest number of lawyers per capita in the United States, with nearly five lawyers per 1,000 residents.
As of 2024, the average salary for a lawyer in Illinois averages around $104,889 annually, which is fairly close to the national average.
Data refers to all lawyers who were actively practicing during this period.
